groups.problem: The Google Meet fallback reads mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration without optional chaining, so it throws when destinationCalendar is null or empty.
groups.rationale: All of them point at EventManager lines 118-119 and flag the same missing optional guard.

groups.problem: When all remaining recurring bookings are cancelled, the deletion branch inside the per-reference loop still uses only the organizer's credentials and each booking's first reference, so other hosts' events are never deleted.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same faulty recurring-deletion logic inside the new loop in handleCancelBooking.

groups.problem: Office365 createEvent always uses the first destination calendar instead of the one matching the current host's credential.
groups.rationale: All of them flag the same Office365 createEvent lines for using the wrong destination for later collective hosts.

groups.problem: evt.destinationCalendar?.push drops the team destination calendars when destinationCalendar is null.
groups.rationale: Both report the same optional push on a null array in handleNewBooking.

groups.problem: The reference mapping sets credentialId to undefined for video (non-calendar) results.
groups.rationale: Both point at EventManager line 170 and report the same lost video credentialId.
